outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution micrograph reconstructions (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows super-resolution micrograph reconstructions, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM bars with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid.
Scatter plot of percentage of molecules in clusters shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid.
Panel F shows micrographs/trajectory reconstructions, not a summary plot of averaged data.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement per trajectory; neither is a bar/mean plot requiring individual point overlay (histograms and line plots are exempt).
Panel H shows trajectory micrographs and a kymograph, not a summary plot of averaged data.
